seoTitle: Paper Trade Stocks, Futures & Options on TradingView
metaDescription: Practice trading stocks, futures, and options risk-free using TradingView's paper trading feature on web and mobile, with steps for Android and iOS.
intro: TradingView's paper trading feature lets you test strategies on stocks, futures, and options using a simulated account, on both the web platform and the mobile app. This guide covers enabling paper trading, placing simulated orders, and tracking your virtual portfolio across devices.

steps.heading: Enable Paper Trading from the Trading Panel
steps.body: Open the Trading Panel on the web platform or mobile app and switch your connection to Paper Trading, which instantly sets up a simulated account.

steps.heading: Connect your simulated account
steps.body: Your paper account comes with virtual buying power so you can practice without linking a real broker.

steps.heading: Place orders across asset types
steps.body: Use market, limit, and stop orders to simulate trades on stocks, and where supported in your region, futures and options symbols too.

steps.heading: Monitor your virtual portfolio
steps.body: Track profit and loss, order history, and open positions from the trading panel to see how your strategy performs over time.

steps.heading: Manage trades on mobile
steps.body: The TradingView app lets you place trades, manage open positions, and set paper trading alerts to refine your entries and exits on the go.

steps.heading: Adjust buying power and sync devices
steps.body: You can adjust your virtual balance, reset your account, and keep your paper trading setup synced between web and mobile.

faq.question: Is paper trading available for futures and options on TradingView?
faq.answer: Yes, where supported in your region you can practice with futures and options symbols using the same paper trading tools.

faq.question: Does paper trading sync between web and mobile?
faq.answer: Yes, your paper trading account and open positions sync across devices when you're signed into the same TradingView account.

faq.question: Can I reset my paper trading balance?
faq.answer: Yes, you can adjust or reset your virtual buying power at any time to start over with a clean account.

faq.question: Do I need a broker to paper trade?
faq.answer: No, paper trading runs on a simulated account, so no real broker connection is required.

faq.question: Can I use alerts with paper trading?
faq.answer: Yes, TradingView alerts work alongside paper trading to help you time your simulated entries and exits.
